{{Top|leg}}
'''The Mines''' was the name given to the lowest lewels of ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'', [[Booster Terrik]]'s private [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. The Mines were restricted to ship's crew and the passengers coming and going on large ships. It included docking bays which were originally designed to house captured enemy starship. The largest of those was [[Docking Bay 15]].
